notes: The load-bearing “by definition” step replaces the cross-correlation matrix identified in the ground truth with a joint 2×2 Pearson matrix, silently treating its diagonal entries as self-correlations. The actual diagonal entry corr(a_i,b_i) equals −1 for a_i=(1,−1) and b_i=(−1,1), despite both variances being positive. The draft therefore proves a statement about a different matrix.
